subject: session date
fact: An hour or so later, the group is ambushed by eight kuo-toans—four creatures attack from the front and four from the rear.
source_quote: An hour or so later, the group is ambushed by eight kuo-toans—four creatures attack from the front and four from the rear.

subject: kuo-toan count
fact: Eight kuo-toans are present in the ambush—four attack from the front and four from the rear.
source_quote: eight kuo-toans—four creatures attack from the front and four from the rear

subject: kuo-toan monitor
fact: A Kuo-Toan monitor is a special kind of Kuo-Toan leader who provides structured organization over a Kuo-Toan group.
source_quote: A Kuo-Toan monitor is a special kind of Kuo-Toan leader who provides structured organization over a Kuo-Toan group.

subject: liquid release
fact: The body of the Kuo-toans releases a particular liquid that causes any melee weapon to stick to their bodies.
source_quote: the body of the Kuo-toans releases a particular liquid that causes any melee weapon to stick to their bodies

subject: crossbow effectiveness
fact: A collection of hand-held crossbows, combined with a united team, can create a powerful enough force to take down even a formidable group of enemies.
source_quote: a collection of hand-held crossbows, combined with a united team, can create a powerful enough force to take down even a formidable group of enemies

subject: kuo-toan flight
fact: Three of the Kuo-toans flee into the Underdark, including the monitor.
source_quote: Three of the Kuo-toans flee into the Underdark, including the monitor.

subject: Sloobludop distance
fact: An hour from Sloobludop, another kuo-toan party appears.
source_quote: An hour from Sloobludop, another kuo-toan party appears.

subject: archpriest identity
fact: This is Ploopploopeen, archpriest of the Seamother.
source_quote: This is Ploopploopeen, archpriest of the Seamother.

subject: language clarity
fact: Not only is their language clear, but also the nuances of their communication and body language.
source_quote: not only is their language clear, but also the nuances of their communication and body language

subject: fish-like movement
fact: The other Kuo-toans will go in front of her, around her, and stay in the back—and it all seems very well choreographed.
source_quote: the other Kuo-toans will go in front of her, around her, and stay in the back. And yet, it all seems very well choreographed.

subject: Sloobludop history
fact: The inhabitants of Sloobludop have lived in harmonious service to the will of the Sea Mother for some time.
source_quote: The inhabitants of Sloobludop have lived in harmonious service to the will of the Sea Mother for some time.

subject: visionary daughter
fact: Bloppblippodd, Ploopploopeen’s daughter, experienced a powerful vision of “Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father,” proclaiming him the new god of her people.
source_quote: Bloppblippodd, Ploopploopeen’s daughter, experienced a powerful vision of “Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father,” proclaiming him the new god of her people.

subject: factional split
fact: We are split in two, fighting among ourselves.
source_quote: We are split in two, fighting among ourselves.

subject: altar offerings
fact: The followers of the Deep Father have been making an increasing number of offerings on his altar — killing blood sacrifices then casting bloody chum into the waters of the Darklake, where it is consumed by … something.
source_quote: The followers of the Deep Father have been making an increasing number of offerings on his altar — killing blood sacrifices then casting bloody chum into the waters of the Darklake, where it is consumed by … something.

subject: bait proposal
fact: I wish to use you as bait.
source_quote: I wish to use you as bait.

subject: infiltration plan
fact: Ploopploopeen wants them to disrupt the upstart faction’s rituals, allowing his true believers of the Sea Mother to cut off the head of the cult.
source_quote: Ploopploopeen wants them to disrupt the upstart faction’s rituals, allowing his true believers of the Sea Mother to cut off the head of the cult.

subject: reward offer
fact: The archpriest promises 500 gold and two potions of healing, then adds two boats and guides to navigate the Darklake.
source_quote: The archpriest promises 500 gold and two potions of healing. But she sees how they are unimpressed, “Two boats and guides to navigate the Darklake?”

subject: faction size avoidance
fact: Do not worry yourself about that. All you have to do is distract Bloppblippodd enough. I will take care of her, and my followers will take care of the followers of this false god.
source_quote: Do not worry yourself about that. All you have to do is distract Bloppblippodd enough. I will take care of her, and my followers will take care of the followers of this false god.

subject: daughter consultation
fact: Perhaps we should talk to his daughter before we take action? I have learned that one must open themselves to all points of view and then only then make decisions and judgments.
source_quote: Perhaps we should talk to his daughter before we take action? I have learned that one must open themselves to all points of view and then only then make decisions and judgments.
